name: io.github.callosium/callosium
title: Callosium
description: One shared memory for every AI you use, in plain Markdown files you own.

packageArguments.description: Serve the brain over MCP on stdio.

packageArguments.name: --brain
packageArguments.description: Path to your brain folder. Run 'callosium' first: the dashboard creates or adopts it.

packageArguments.name: --agent
packageArguments.description: Agent id for this AI client, issued by the dashboard's Agents screen.

packageArguments.name: --token
packageArguments.description: Token for this agent, issued alongside the id. Scopes which folders this AI may read.

environmentVariables.name: CALLOSIUM_MODEL_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where the local embedding model is cached. Defaults to a per-user cache directory.
